D.t: Todd Achilles trails by 20.9 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 75,911 voters switching sides, or 151,823 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +27.6 and R +13.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is R +18.8. Your best recent poll is Advanced Targeting Research at D +4.1; your worst is Peak Insights (R) at R +22.1. 4 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Ada, a projected net 23,387 votes; Blaine, a projected net 5,781 votes; Latah, a projected net 2,450 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Todd Achilles runs furthest behind in Idaho, Jefferson, Cassia. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

The forecast's worst groups for Todd Achilles: Immigration voters 20 to 75, Small counties 29 to 63, Midsize counties 30 to 61. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
